newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold prices seen down on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold prices seen down on low demand.

text.p: Pakistan gold prices are likely to plunge further on low demand in domestic market and falling international rates, dealers said on Monday.
Gold rates hit a new year-low of 4,398 rupees per 10 grams on Saturday from 4,415 on Friday.

"Gold rates will ease further this week in line to the international market," dealer Farooq Qureshi said. "Demand has also drastically dropped in the local market and people are under pressure owing to the country's economic problems."
Silver prices are also under pressure, dealers said.
